verdict.rationale: There is concrete evidence of file/data upload (upload a directory to the data storage service, docs-34) and of agents/tasks that analyze uploaded datasets (Kosmos taking 'one or more datasets', Analysis processing experimental data), plus chat sessions retaining workspace files across turns. However, evidence does not explicitly confirm uploading arbitrary PDFs/corpus as literature source material for the Literature/Kosmos agent to search over (its literature capability is framed around its own 175M+ paper index, not user-supplied PDFs). missing for 10: explicit documentation that user-uploaded PDFs/corpus are ingested and queried by the literature-review agent, and an independent/hands-on confirmation of this workflow.
